newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY'S FORINT ENDS FIRMER VS DLR, NBH BASKET.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY'S FORINT ENDS FIRMER VS DLR, NBH BASKET.

text.p: Hungary's forint firmed against the dollar and narrowed the gap that separated it from the central bank's resistance level (bid), traders said on Thursday.
The forint closed at 181.00/05 against the U.S. unit compared wit an opening of 181.40/45 and 181.05/10 at the midday break.
"The forint firmed as the mark gained against the dollar," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank.
The forint was some five pips off the central bank bid at closing, compared with 10 to 15 pips at midday.
(National Bank of Hungary (NBH) basket: 30 pct dollar + 70 pct mark. The NBH's intervention range is 4.5 percent wide.)
